summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of two series of its senior callable notes: $1.5B 5.985% Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2027 and $500M Floating Rate Notes due 2027. The redemption will occur on August 7, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. The notes will be delisted from the NYSE thereafter. This is a routine debt redemption event, not a special situation. No deal terms are relevant.
